info.description:
Rate limiting

Requests are limited to 1200 requests per fixed 10-minute window. If you exceed this limit, you will receive a 429 Too Many Requests response.
Current rate limit status is available in RateLimit header. Example: RateLimit: limit=1200, remaining=956, reset=543. See IETF draft for more details.

Pagination

Max results per page is 50. Use page and per_page query parameters to fetch additional results. Example: /users?page=3&per_page=30.

post.description:
Returns metadata that can be used to upload a file to the server and then attach it to a Resource, e.g. as an User Avatar or a Post Attachment.
An actual file has to be uploaded to the returned `upload_url`. cURL example: ``` curl -X PUT -H "Content-Type: image/png" -T "image.png" {upload_url} ``` Successfully uploaded file can be then attached to a Resource (e.g. User or Post) using the returned `id`. See UserAvatars and Posts documentation for more details. Notes: 1. `upload_url` is valid for 5 minutes. 1. An uploaded file is removed from the server after 24 hours. It has to be attached to a Resource before that.

update_tree_structure.description:
Must be `true` if the new Parent `level` is different than the previous Parent `level`.
If set to `true`, the Group's `level` and Group's descendants `level` will be updated based on the new Parent `level`. For example, if the Group is `level_3` and the new Parent is `level_1`, the Group will be updated to `level_2`, the Group's children to `level_3`, and so on.

parameters.name: filter[comments_count_lteq]
parameters.description:
Filter resources by comments_count. For example, you can find resources with comments_count greater than 1.

comments_count is integer, i.e. an integer number.

comments_count represents the total number of comments that a Post have received..

Allowed operators:

  • lteq
  • lt
  • gteq
  • gt

Examples: 

?filter[comments_count_lt]=1    # less than 1
?filter[comments_count_lteq]=3  # less than or equal to 3
?filter[comments_count_gt]=6    # greater than 6
?filter[comments_count_gteq]=20  # greater than or equal to 20

lteq_1.summary: Returns resources where comments_count is less or equal than 1.

lteq_2.summary: Returns resources where comments_count is less or equal than 3.
